$Comment: One of Elsie's plain errands, on her own board (Christmas_Weaver_Jobs): put up Christmas decorations at
home. PLACE_BLOCK counts each one placed, and the PREFIX match takes the game's own winter pieces
(WinterHoliday_: the garland, lights, stocking, snowman, snowflake, bauble and the rest), its wreath
(Winter_Holiday_Wreath, spelt apart) and its Christmas Packets (Furniture_Christmas_Chest_Small_, every
colour), the same pieces the Christmas Decorator achievement counts. Nothing can be placed in the
Forgotten Temple, so it is done at home.
